title: Roll Out, Roll Back, and Verify
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Roll Out, Roll Back, and Verify.
learning_objectives: Explain roll out, roll back, and verify using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for roll out, roll back, and verify
Assess failure and operational limits of roll out, roll back, and verify
concepts_covered: A rollout status confirms a Deployment update; rollout undo returns to a prior revision, subject to retained history.
The sample manifest declares a staged Rollout resource; verifier can check nodes, etcd, and local-path state.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
